exposure: hysteroscopic-assisted laparoscopic incised-suture method for previous cesarean scar defects (PCSD)
hysteroscopic-assisted laparoscopic folded-suture method for previous cesarean scar defects (PCSD)
outcome: cure or effective rates regarding menstrual abnormalities
average time after surgery to pregnancy
cohort: The study included 95 patients with previous cesarean scar defects (PCSD) who underwent hysteroscopic-assisted laparoscopic surgery.
finding: Both incised and folded suturing methods are effective for PCSD treatment, but the folded-suture method is associated with a shorter operation time, less intraoperative hemorrhage, greater desire for postoperative fertility, and a shorter average time to pregnancy.
followup_time: 1-year post-surgery (for menstrual abnormalities); average time after surgery to pregnancy also measured.
